summary: Implemented `in` membership for Namespace and ClosedNamespace in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ does node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs (inherited by _RDFNamespace); the ClosedNamespace IPython completion hook now lists dir(str(self.uri)). Added tests in test/test_namespace.py covering prefix positive/negative/self/SH, RDFS closed positive/negative/plain string/Literal/container, and RDF closed positive/container. Tests and doctests were not run, per instructions; no commit made.
